source.inspectionScope: Exact bounded source read; parameter/configuration roles, no transform or release-task execution.
source.symbol: Initial tag revision task context release-early-tagging
source.validation: Exact named Git revision, blob and source bytes checked; no runtime or unchanged-caller claim.

text:
transforms:
    - taskgraph.transforms.task_context
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.release_deps:transforms
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.resolve_landoscript_keyed_by:transforms
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.task:transforms

task-defaults:
    run-on-repo-type: [hg]
    description: Release Promotion version tag for buildN
    run-on-projects: []
    shipping-phase: promote
    task-context:
        from-parameters:
            head_rev: head_rev
        substitution-fields:
            - worker.actions
    worker-type: lando
    worker:
        implementation: scriptworker-lando
        repo-param-prefix: comm_
        lando-repo:
            by-project:
                comm-beta: thunderbird-desktop-beta
                comm-release: thunderbird-desktop-release
                comm-esr153: thunderbird-desktop-esr153
                try-comm-central:
                    by-release-type:
                        beta: staging-thunderbird-beta
                        release: staging-thunderbird-release
                        esr153: staging-thunderbird-esr153
                        default: ""
                default: ""
        actions:
            - tag:
                  types: ["buildN"]
                  revision: "{head_rev}"

                  # Used to map hg revisions to the git revisions that scriptworker-lando needs
                  hg-repo-url:
title: Initial tag revision task context release-early-tagging
